skill.name: global-error-handling
skill.description: Guides AI coding agents to implement centralized, user-friendly error handling with specific exceptions, graceful degradation, retry strategies, and resource cleanup.
skill.summary: Apply consistent error handling patterns across services, controllers, APIs, and external service integrations.
skill.author: DevanB

content.value_statement: Many applications expose confusing errors, leak details, or handle failures inconsistently. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward centralized handlers, specific exceptions, safe messages, retries, and cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Recommends centralized error handling at controllers, API layers, and service boundaries.
Guides creation of custom exception classes for specific failure scenarios.
Promotes user-friendly messages that avoid exposing technical details.
Covers fail-fast validation and precondition checks before risky operations.
Includes graceful degradation, transient failure handling, and retry strategies with exponential backoff.
Reminds agents to clean up file handles, database connections, and other resources.
limitations: Does not include framework-specific middleware code.
Depends on the agent or developer to apply the guidance correctly.
The detailed standards file is referenced outside this packaged skill.
Does not replace security review for logging, retries, or user-facing errors.

use_cases.title: API Error Responses
use_cases.description: Design consistent API errors that avoid leaking stack traces or internal implementation details.

use_cases.title: Service Resilience
use_cases.description: Handle transient service failures with retries, degradation, and clear permanent failure behavior.

use_cases.title: Code Review Standards
use_cases.description: Check pull requests for scattered catch blocks, missing cleanup, and unclear exception boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Handling
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one endpoint or function.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the global-error-handling skill to improve this function. Add specific exceptions, safe user messages, and cleanup where needed.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Controller Errors
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for controller or API boundaries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the global-error-handling skill to this controller. Centralize error responses and keep technical details in logs only.

prompt_templates.title: Design Failure Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the global-error-handling skill to design handling for this external service. Separate transient failures, permanent failures, retries, and degradation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Error Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this module with the global-error-handling skill. Identify weak exception types, scattered catch blocks, unsafe logs, and missing cleanup.

output_examples.input: A service catches every exception and returns a technical stack trace.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend specific exceptions, sanitized user messages, and centralized logging at an API boundary.

output_examples.input: An integration fails when a third-party API has a temporary outage.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest transient failure handling, bounded retries, graceful degradation, and clear permanent failure behavior.

output_examples.input: A database operation opens a connection and may fail before closing it.
output_examples.output: The skill would highlight resource cleanup in a finally block or equivalent language construct.

best_practices: Keep user messages clear while logging technical details in protected logs.
Handle errors at stable boundaries, such as controllers, APIs, and service adapters.
Pair retries with limits, backoff, and clear handling for permanent failures.
anti_patterns: Do not catch broad exceptions without preserving useful diagnostic context.
Do not expose stack traces, database errors, or secret values to users.
Do not scatter duplicate error response logic across many unrelated functions.

faq.question: Does this skill run code?
faq.answer: No. It provides written guidance for AI coding agents and does not include scripts or executables.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it tied to one programming language?
faq.answer: No. The guidance is language-neutral and focuses on error handling concepts.

faq.question: Can it design retry behavior?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers transient failures, permanent failures, exponential backoff, and graceful degradation.

faq.question: Does it prevent all sensitive data leaks?
faq.answer: No. It recommends safer messages and logging, but code still needs security review.

faq.question: Why is there a security warning?
faq.answer: The skill references a file outside its package with a parent-directory path.
